nodes.title: Hypothesis-revision-release port test correction
nodes.summary: Corrects hypothesis-revision-release.port.spec.ts, a file this project already delivered, so its assertion matches the domain-depends-on-no-infrastructure constraint's actual scope rather than a stricter, unstated rule.

nodes.title: Narrow hypothesis-revision-release.port.spec.ts's overly strict import assertion
nodes.summary: The test asserts the port declares no import at all, stricter than the constraint actually requires (no framework, driver or provider-client import); its sibling port test already asserts the correct, narrower rule.
